behaviours.title: speculative decode default off
behaviours.statement: Speculative decoding paths (user draft, event horizon, eagle5) are default-off. Enabling requires explicit CLI flags or env vars.

behaviours.title: user-draft is lossless vs plain greedy when enabled
behaviours.statement: With --user-draft (HAWKING_QWEN_USER_DRAFT=1), the per-user n-gram speculative draft uses propose→batched-verify→accept; output is bit-identical to plain greedy (temp=0 + TCB). Without the flag the draft path is never entered.
behaviours.reproduction: compare generate with and without --user-draft at temp 0

behaviours.title: user-draft-propose-first changes only scheduling
behaviours.statement: --user-draft-propose-first selects propose-first loop (1 verify forward/cycle) vs default bonus-first (2 forwards/cycle); bit-identical outputs, scheduling differs.

behaviours.title: serve/generate --speculate mode optional
behaviours.statement: --speculate accepts a mode (default_missing exact-shared) with --verify-window (default 4) for speculative verification windows on serve/generate/bench/batch-hash.
behaviours.observable_outputs: speculative verify behaviour when mode set

behaviours.title: profile fast is mild quality trade; exact is bit-identical
behaviours.statement: --profile fast enables vocab-prune-32k + Q4K LM-head + Q4K FFN-down + predec + f16-scales (mild quality trade). --profile exact forces bit-identical conservative path with quality levers forced off.
behaviours.observable_outputs: different speed/quality; exact bit-identical to locked default path without quality trades
behaviours.performance_budget: fast ~+3–7% warm noisy on Qwen2.5-3B campaign numbers; identity 83–90%

behaviours.title: Q4K predec and Q6K swiglu 2r are default-on speed levers
behaviours.statement: HAWKING_QWEN_Q4K_PREDEC default ON (bit-identical core decode win) and HAWKING_QWEN_Q6K_SWIGLU_2R default ON (optimal 2 rows/simdgroup). Opt-out via =0.

behaviours.title: INT4_KV per-row is fail-loud disabled
behaviours.statement: HAWKING_QWEN_INT4_KV is DISABLED fail-loud (NO-GO: per-row outlier collapse). Experimental force-enable is for redesign only. Per-channel INT4_KV_PC is the live compression research lever.
behaviours.security_boundary: must not silently enable broken per-row int4 KV as default

behaviours.title: F16_KV halves KV footprint for long context
behaviours.statement: HAWKING_QWEN_F16_KV / serve --f16-kv halves KV memory with measured mild identity trade; --no-f16-kv forces off. Useful long-context lever.

behaviours.title: generate produces tokens to stdout from prompt
behaviours.statement: hawking generate --weights <gguf> --prompt <text> --max-new-tokens N loads the model and writes generated text to stdout. Default max_new_tokens=256, max_seq_len=4096, temperature=0.0 (greedy), top_k=40, top_p=0.95.
behaviours.inputs: GGUF weights; prompt; sampling knobs; optional seed
behaviours.observable_outputs: generated text on stdout; exit 0 on success
side_effects: none durable unless capture flags set
behaviours.failure_behaviour: missing weights → non-zero; kv cache full → error message kv cache full at N

behaviours.title: greedy temperature zero is deterministic with seed
behaviours.statement: With temperature 0 (default) and an explicit seed when non-greedy knobs are used, generation is intended for parity debugging; greedy token ids can be traced with --trace-tokens.
behaviours.observable_outputs: stable token stream for parity gates

behaviours.title: CPU force path supports Metal parity for small dense
behaviours.statement: With HAWKING_FORCE_CPU=1, the engine can run without Metal. Documented parity: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Q4_K_M CPU↔Metal 12/12 leading greedy token IDs identical. Dense models only for this claim.
behaviours.observable_outputs: greedy token ids matching Metal path
behaviours.failure_behaviour: MoE CPU decode not covered by the stated parity claim
behaviours.reproduction: HAWKING_FORCE_CPU=1 cargo run -p hawking -- generate --weights <qwen05b.gguf> --prompt x --max-new-tokens 12 --temperature 0 --trace-tokens

behaviours.title: memory_limit_mb fails closed at load if exceeded
behaviours.statement: When --memory-limit-mb is set non-zero, the engine errors at load time if the model file exceeds the limit. Pass 0 for auto (80% of system RAM). Default unlimited.

behaviours.title: max_seq_len allocates KV; overflow errors
behaviours.statement: KV cache is allocated at --max-seq-len (default 4096). Prompt+generation exceeding capacity surfaces an error of the form 'kv cache full at N'.

behaviours.title: batched capture writes sharded JSONL completions
behaviours.statement: With --batched-capture and --prompts-file and --capture-out, generate runs up to --capture-batch sequences through multiseq (greedy only) and flushes sharded JSONL. Bit-identical to single-stream greedy capture when the multiseq seam exists; clear error otherwise.
behaviours.failure_behaviour: engine without multiseq seam → clear error

behaviours.title: Qwen2.5-3B-Q4_K_M is the verified primary dense target
behaviours.statement: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct Q4_K_M is documented as the verified primary target with greedy + multiseq token parity gates and W4A8 cosine quality gate; coherent generation is expected when weights are present.
